column3: Close to the Hebrew; “a maskil” is rendered “A Contemplation.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the ruins of perpetuity” is rendered “the perpetual desolations.”
Close to the Hebrew; מוֹעֲדֶךָ (“your meeting place”) is rendered “Your meeting place,” and the first “signs” “banners.”
The verse is obscure; NKJV renders “They seem like men who lift up Axes among the thick trees.”
Close to the Hebrew; וְכֵילַפֹּת (“crowbars”) is rendered “hammers.”
Close to the Hebrew; נִינָם (“let us oppress”) is rendered “Let us destroy them.”
Close to the Hebrew; תַנִּינִים (“sea monsters”) is rendered “the sea serpents.”
Close to the Hebrew; “to a people, to desert creatures” is rendered “to the people inhabiting the wilderness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “ever-flowing rivers” is rendered “mighty rivers.”
Close to the Hebrew; מָאוֹר (“a light-giver”) is rendered “the light.”
Close to the Hebrew; “settlements of violence” is rendered “the haunts of cruelty.”
